process_area.title: Temporary Facility & Parking Lot Sales Mobilization

fields.Participants: Construction Contractor, LP Officer, LGU Permit Officer
fields.Trigger: Store tagged Red or Yellow (W5274) with reconstruction timeline > 30 days

workflows.name: Temporary Container Sales Office Site Selection and Setup

Controls: - CTL-28: petty cash security controls; LP Director sign-off required.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unsecure office risk**: Temporary office burglarized due to poor locking systems; mitigated by installing heavy steel doors, deadbolts, and dedicated night guard patrol.

steps.activity: Identify secure layout area in parking lot or adjacent clear lot for temporary setup.
Mobilize mobile office containers (typically 20-foot shipping container offices).
Connect utilities (temporary electrical drop, water, network cabling).
Install secure locks, safe box, and perimeter lighting.

fields.Participants: Store Manager, Network Analyst, Security Analyst

workflows.name: Mobile POS Terminal Routing and Network Activation

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-switching dual SIM cellular failover routing integration.
Controls: - CTL-20: Ensure POS cash accountability; CIO terminal activation approval.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transaction offline loss risk**: Unstable cellular connection drops transactions sync, causing cash discrepancies; mitigated by deploying POS terminals configured with offline database store-and-forward features.

steps.activity: Deploy mobile POS terminal units, receipt printers, and barcode scanners to site.
Establish secure network tunnel via dual cellular LTE/5G SIM routers.
Verify POS software transactions processing, receipt printing, and e-wallet connectivity.
Audit security logs ensuring terminal transactions encryption.

fields.Participants: LGU electrical inspector, private utility partner representative, Store Manager

workflows.name: Temporary Utility Connection and Safety Accreditation

Controls: - CTL-784: personnel safety verification; engineering supervisor formal sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Electrocution risk**: Water leaks near temporary electrical panel causing short circuits; mitigated by positioning utility connections on opposite sides of the container and testing ground resistance.
System Touchpoints: - LGU Permitting system (VS-76), Facilities maintenance log (VS-138.2).

steps.activity: Apply for temporary electrical and water connection with local distribution utilities.
Run armored cabling from nearest unaffected substation to distribution panel on container office.
Install safety grounding rod and verify electrical insulation values.
Coordinate safety walk-through inspection with LGU building official; obtain temporary utility safety sign-off.

fields.Participants: Store Manager, Cashier, Armored Car Driver
fields.Trigger: Utilities active at temporary container office (W5291)

workflows.name: Emergency Vault and Cash Staging Security Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Alarm system monitoring with automated status updates sent to corporate security dashboard.
Controls: - CTL-20: Cash handling controls; LP Manager safe code approval.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cash transport theft risk**: Criminal elements target cash transfer from temporary container to armored truck in parking area; mitigated by enforcing dual-custody LP escort and parking CIT truck directly outside the container.
System Touchpoints: - LP Alarm portal, Cash Management module (VS-81).

steps.activity: Bolt heavy-duty fireproof drop-safe to reinforced steel framing of the container structure.
Install cellular-communicating alarm system and high-definition IP camera facing the safe area.
Program access codes for authorized store managers only; test emergency panic button link to local PNP.
Issue keys for safe deposit boxes and verify cash custody sign-off registers.

fields.Participants: VP Store Operations, LGU Permit Officer, Store Manager
fields.Trigger: Decision to deploy temporary selling office (W5274)

workflows.name: LGU Temporary Selling Permit Application and Zoning Variance

Automation Opportunity: - Digital document transmission to municipal licensing database.
Controls: - CTL-41: LGU permit compliance controls; VP Store Operations sign-off.
Cross-references: - links to VS-76 (LGU compliance), VS-22 (regulatory compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Shut-down citation risk**: Store cited for running unpermitted outdoor commercial activities by municipal building official; mitigated by securing zoning variance before container delivery.

steps.activity: Draft temporary outdoor sales application detailing container layout, parking impact, and safety measures.
Secure municipal zoning variance endorsement from local Barangay and LGU Civil Defense.
Pay temporary permit fees at city hall and submit completed dossier.
Collect official Temporary Selling Permit and display at container entrance.

fields.Participants: Stock Associate, DC Dispatcher, Regional Merchandiser
fields.Trigger: Mobile POS activation (W5290) and temporary selling permit secured (W5293)

workflows.name: High-Priority Safety and Reconstruction Material Stocking

Automation Opportunity: - Automated stock transfer creation based on regional disaster demand profile.
Controls: - CTL-24: Receiving integrity verification; Store Manager approval on stock levels.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Material degradation risk**: Staged building materials (cement, drywall) ruined by rain due to poor coverage; mitigated by storing all moisture-sensitive inventory inside weather-tight containers.
System Touchpoints: - Transfer Order portal (VS-05.2), Warehouse Dispatch module (VS-04).

steps.activity: Define core SKU list for temporary container: cement, plywood, nails, tarps, electrical wire, hand tools.
Route emergency transfer order to regional DC for immediate flatbed delivery to temporary site.
Devise secure containerized weather-resistant inventory cages in designated parking bays.
Scan received materials into temporary inventory sub-location in ERP.

fields.Participants: Store Manager, LP Officer, Regional Operations Manager
fields.Trigger: Safety, security, utility, and inventory setup complete (W5292, W5294)

workflows.name: Temporary Site Handover and Store Manager Operations Sign-off

Automation Opportunity: - Paperless digital handover checklists with photo attachments.
Controls: - CTL-784: facilities asset verification evidence; ROM approval on operations start.
Cross-references: - links to VS-138 (facilities), VS-29 (master data), VS-07 (store operations)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Handover oversight risk**: Operational staff take custody of temporary site with faulty electrical wiring or alarm systems; mitigated by requiring dual sign-offs from both facilities engineer and store manager.

steps.activity: Conduct final facility checklist inspection: power check, POS check, lock check, safety sign check.
Review security alarm system status and log communication with central monitoring station.
Execute formal temporary site handover document in ERP.
Declare temporary container store "Active for Trading" in master store locator.

fields.Participants: Logistics Coordinator, LP Specialist, Utility Technician

workflows.name: Temporary Facility Decommissioning and Site Re-entry Checklist

Automation Opportunity: - Automated pickup scheduling alerts integrated with container leasing partner systems.
Controls: - CTL-26: Asset disposal controls; Store Manager final decommissioning clearance.
Cross-references: - links to VS-35 (fixed assets), VS-99 (IT assets), VS-138 (facilities)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Asset abandonment risk**: High-value security equipment or POS terminals left behind in container during logistics pickup; mitigated by matching physical equipment serial numbers against original staging manifest.
System Touchpoints: - Store Status system, Fixed Asset module (VS-35), IT Asset module (VS-99).

steps.activity: Terminating utility connections (electrical, water) and coordinate technician meter disconnection.
De-authorize mobile POS network tunnels and remove all terminal hardware, cash safe, and LP cameras.
Clear remaining physical inventory from parking lot cages and return to main store shelves.
Demobilize office container units from parking lot; execute final site restoration and cleanup.
